thread:
Lina W: FYI I pushed Orpheus-v2 int8 (qkernel 1.2.5) to staging. Quick locale smoke shows merged CJK number+unit tokens and mirrored parentheses in Arabic lines. Small but reproducible.
Mei Chen: Can you paste the exact call and outputs?
Lina W: Copied from staging (run: stg-1765432100).
Input:
```
请在 2025 年 12 月 01 日 提交报告 (due: 12/01/2025)
راجِع الوثيقة (01/12/2025)
```
FP16 baseline:
```
请在 2025 年 12 月 01 日 提交报告 (due: 12/01/2025)
راجِع الوثيقة (01/12/2025)
```
INT8 staging:
```
请在2025年12月01日提交报告 )due: 12/01/2025(
راجِع الوثيقة )01/12/2025(
```
Notes: spaces between digits and unit characters removed in Chinese; ASCII parentheses reversed in Arabic.
Kevin L: We enabled fused-kvfold + changed int8 quant to symmetric per-channel with nearest-even rounding in this build. Likely the logits nudged across token boundaries.
Jordan P: Can you re-run with `return_tokens=true`? Need to confirm token ids changed vs detok bug.
Lina W: With return_tokens I see int8 emits a single token for `2025年` while fp16 emits [`2025`, ` `, `年`]. So tokenization/sampling path changed.
Kevin L: Quick mitigation: revert fused-kvfold and try asymmetric per-tensor quant. I'll queue patch.
infra-bot: deploy:staging-orpheus-int8-patch started (build: 20260501.1)
QA-bot: Suggested thresholds: block if zh chrF drop >0.4 or ar BLEU drop >1.0.
Mei Chen: I'll run the small locale harness and post diffs. Also Jordan, please add a tiny regression set: ["2025 \u5e74", "(01/12/2025)", "10 \u6708"].
Jordan P: Will add tests and a deterministic logits-threshold unit to CI.
Lina W: Thanks all — will follow up with smoke results. :mag:
